originality.rationale: The exact degree-resolved Jordan-string spectrum for wedge multiplication by every alternating-rank bivector, in all odd finite characteristics, is not the Boolean inclusion-matrix diagonal theorem itself or the classical form-rank frequency theorem. The proof assembles those antecedents via a graded exterior-module decomposition and a modular rank-to-string inversion; a dimensional-eight characteristic-three/five contrast demonstrates meaningful new scope. Targeted published-record and primary-literature comparisons found no direct stronger result among inspected sources; older modular symplectic representation-theory coverage remains a substantive priority risk, and search failure is not uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Modular symplectic representation and Lefschetz-theory literature may encode an equivalent all-parameter exterior-wedge classification without explicit modern wording.
